records.description: Contains the records that must be configured.

valid.description: True if all `records` are valid. If false, see `records` for errors.

domain.description: The domain for which the DNS record must be added.

type.description: What kind of DNS record this is.

value.description: The required value of the DNS record.

valid.description: Whether the DNS record has been setup correctly.

dnsCorrect.description: True if record is valid on account of the DNS record being correctly configured.

dnsValidationOverride.description: True if record is valid on account of Signicat having configured a special override.

partnerWildcardDns.description: True if record is valid of domain being a verified partner DNS domain.

pointsToSignicatIdentityBrokerCname.description: True if the current DNS record is pointing to Signicat Identity Broker's domain.
